ImperiusCelestialChargeImpalingLight.name: Impaling Light
ImperiusCelestialChargeImpalingLight.description: Celestial Charge's final damage is increased by 75% and its cooldown is reduced by 1.25 seconds for each Valorous Brand on the target when the Stun completes.

ImperiusSolarionsFireConsumingFlame.name: Consuming Flame
ImperiusSolarionsFireConsumingFlame.description: Increase the center damage of Solarion's Fire by an additional 125% and its Slow amount by 15%. The first enemy Hero hit with Solarion's Fire restores 30 Mana.

ImperiusValorousBrandBurnTheImpure.name: Burn the Impure
ImperiusValorousBrandBurnTheImpure.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

ImperiusMoltenArmorSovereignArmor.name: Sovereign Armor
ImperiusMoltenArmorSovereignArmor.description: Molten Armor grants 20 Armor for 1.5 seconds. Damaging an enemy Hero with Molten Armor increases the duration of the Armor by 0.5 seconds.

ImperiusValorousBrandBattleHunger.name: Battle Hunger
ImperiusValorousBrandBattleHunger.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

ImperiusPressForward.name: Press Forward
ImperiusPressForward.description: Gain 10 Armor while being healed by a Regeneration Globe. Damaging an enemy Hero sets the duration of an active Regeneration Globe on Imperius to 8 seconds (unless it is already higher).

ImperiusCelestialChargeFlashOfAnger.name: Flash of Anger
ImperiusCelestialChargeFlashOfAnger.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 (+4% per level) point Shield for 4 seconds.

ImperiusSolarionsFireBlazeOfGlory.name: Blaze of Glory
ImperiusSolarionsFireBlazeOfGlory.description: Solarion's Fire leaves a line of scorched earth along its center that explodes after 2 seconds for 205 (+4% per level) damage, dealing bonus damage with Valorous Brand marks.

ImperiusHolyFervor.name: Holy Fervor
ImperiusHolyFervor.description: Activate to cause the next 4 Basic Attacks within 10 seconds to cleave for 30% additional damage. Passive: Casting Molten Armor grants Holy Fervor for 2 Basic Attacks.

ImperiusAngelicArmaments.name: Angelic Armaments
ImperiusAngelicArmaments.description: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds. If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

ImperiusWrathOfTheAngiris.name: Wrath of the Angiris
ImperiusWrathOfTheAngiris.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving. After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 375 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1

ImperiusCelestialChargePatheticMortals.name: Pathetic Mortals
ImperiusCelestialChargePatheticMortals.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

ImperiusMoltenArmorDivineRage.name: Divine Rage
ImperiusMoltenArmorDivineRage.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark reduces the cooldown of Molten Armor by 1 second.

ImperiusMoltenArmorHeatOfBattle.name: Heat of Battle
ImperiusMoltenArmorHeatOfBattle.description: Increase Molten Armor's healing against Heroes by 2% for every 1% Health Imperius is missing.

ImperiusCelestialChargeCelestialSwiftnes.name: Celestial Swiftness
ImperiusCelestialChargeCelestialSwiftnes.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero stunned with Celestial Charge.

ImperiusMoltenArmorMeltingTouch.name: Melting Touch
ImperiusMoltenArmorMeltingTouch.description: Consuming a Molten Armor mark reduces the target's Armor by 25 for 4 seconds.

ImperiusValorousPursuit.name: Valorous Pursuit
ImperiusValorousPursuit.description: Activate to teleport to an enemy that has been marked by Valorous Brand and gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

ImperiusAngelicArmamentsHeavenlyHost.name: Heavenly Host
ImperiusAngelicArmamentsHeavenlyHost.description: Nearby allied Heroes gain 600 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds. If the Shield lasts the full duration, fire a sword at the nearest enemy Hero, dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage.

ImperiusWrathOfTheAngirisUnrelentingDesc.name: Unrelenting Descent
ImperiusWrathOfTheAngirisUnrelentingDesc.description: Descending from the Heavens restores 30% of Imperius' maximum Health and Mana. Consuming a Valorous Brand reduces the cooldown of Wrath of the Angiris by 10 seconds.

ImperiusValorousBrandBrandOfSolarion.name: Brand of Solarion
ImperiusValorousBrandBrandOfSolarion.description: Reduce the duration of Valorous Brand to 5 seconds, but it is no longer consumed when triggered.

ImperiusImpervious.name: Impervious
ImperiusImpervious.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 75 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Hitting Heroes with the center of Solarion's Fire reduces this cooldown by 5 seconds.
